6391df52d146a40007c265f3: The Nanny: The Tart With Heart
Upon returning from Paris, Maxwell takes back his loving words to Fran.
Ordered to discourage Maggie from seeing an older guy, Fran suddenly finds herself dating his best friend.
Brighton faces a year at military school unless he improves his grades at school.
Fran is hired as a regular on The Rosie O'Donnell Show.
Fran's Aunt Freida arrives at the Sheffields after being evicted.
The Nanny: Me And Mrs. Joan
Fran arranges a reunion between Maxwell and his estranged father, James.
While she's supposed to be watching Jay Leno's dog, Fran is distracted by an untimely tax audit.
The Nanny: An Affair To Dismember
As Fran wonders what to do about her flagging love life, Maxwell's handsome younger brother proposes marriage.
Maxwell is aroused after learning that Fran has a secret tattoo.
Fran enters a beauty contest to win a car for Maggie's birthday.
Fran decides on a holiday vacation away from the Sheffields, only to find herself caught in a hurricane.
The Nanny: Danny's Dead And Who's Got The Will?
Fran goes to her former fiance Danny's funeral, and fearing she may end up alone, she pushes Maxwell for a commitment.
Fran's finds the perfect new boyfriend, only to discover that he's also her cousin.
At the advice of her therapist, Fran is determined to rid her life of men.
Maxwell suspects Fran's therapist is pushing her into an affair.
Fran and Sylvia are taken hostage in a Valentine's Day bank robbery.
The Nanny: Samson, He Denied Her
Fran joins C.C. on the jury of a controversial case.
The Nanny: The Facts Of Life
Fran suspects Niles if being a killer.
Fran discovers she may have been switched at birth with the daughter of wealthy parents.
The Nanny: The Nanny And The Hunk Producer
A tabloid starts to publish fake stories about Maxwell and Fran having an affair when Maxwell was still married.
The Nanny: The Passed Over Story
An successful high school classmate of Fran's tempts Maggie with a job offer.
The Nanny: No Muse Is Good Muse
Fran convince a rock star to let her be her muse.
The Nanny: You Bette Your Life
Fran offers her services for a charity auction presided over by Bette Midler.
The Nanny: The Heather Biblow Story
Fran's old nemesis lands a role on a popular soap opera.
Fran is upset after learning her mother is planning to move to Florida.
The Nanny: Fran's Gotta Have It
Fran's attempt to cement her relationship with Maxwell is rudely interrupted when Niles has a heart attack.
Worried that Maxwell is going to abandon her, Fran seeks advice from her cousin Sheila.
Maxwell invites Fran to an exclusive dinner with singer Elton John.
The Nanny: The Bobbi Fleckman Story
Fran is led to believe that a female record company executive is after Maxwell.
Fran takes a job walking C.C.'s dog, only to have it kidnapped.
Fran and C.C. appeal to Dr. Joyce Brothers to decide who's best for Maxwell; Niles' snooping gets him fired.
Fran's date with comedian Chevy Chase makes Maxwell jealous.
Fran and Val square when the Southeast Asian girl they adopted years ago comes to town.
Yetta's fiancee gets Fran an audition with newsman Bryant Gumbel.
Maggie's philosophy professor falls for Fran.
The Nanny: From Flushing With Love
Fran uses a trip to Niagara Falls to inspire Maxwell to propose.
Fran's attempt to treat her hemorrhoids proves embarrassing.
